description: Current SDR behavior is pinned to Freecut. Linear display-referred BT.709 HDR uses straight alpha and 1.0 = 203 cd/m². Unmigrated operators throw HdrRenderUnavailableError; refusal is regression coverage, not HDR rendering qualification.

workingSpace.sdr: sRGB-encoded BT.709; pinned upstream parameters and clamps
workingSpace.hdr: linear display-referred BT.709, straight alpha, 1.0 = 203 cd/m²

historicalEncodedHdr.acceptance: Historical extended sRGB-encoded contract only; cannot qualify current linear HDR.

contract.description: FL-99 / FL-97 declared behaviour of every GPU transition, verified by tools/transition-matrix.browser.mjs. All transitions: finite, deterministic, SDR float route equals the rgba8unorm route, HDR float endpoints are exactly the outgoing/incoming clip. hdrMidpoint: extended = light above reference white survives the midpoint; dip/averaged/edge-on explain why it cannot. mirrorSymmetric: from-right/from-bottom are mirror images of from-left/from-top. sdrEndpointOffset: Freecut's SDR route does not show the clip exactly at progress 0 and 1 (pinned upstream behaviour). sdrParityBudget: channels allowed to differ between SDR routes.

additiveDissolve.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

blurDissolve.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

chromatic.semantics: Channel-split sweep; opposite directions are mirror images. Freecut leaves a split residual at progress 0 and 1 on the SDR route; HDR float endpoints are the clips exactly.

clockWipe.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

dipToColorDissolve.semantics: Dips through the authored colour, which the midpoint shows instead of either clip.

dissolve.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

fade.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

filmGateSlip.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

flip.semantics: The card is edge-on at the midpoint, so it shows neither clip.

glitch.semantics: Hash-driven glitch bands; quantising the inputs can move up to a few texels across a band edge between the float and rgba8 SDR routes.

iris.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

lensWarpZoom.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

lightLeakBurn.semantics: Film light leak; directions are not mirror images because the leak texture is fixed in screen space. Freecut leaves leak light at progress 0 and 1 on the SDR route; HDR float endpoints are the clips exactly.

liquidDistort.semantics: Noise-driven liquid warp; directions are not mirror images because the noise field is fixed in screen space. Freecut leaves distortion at progress 0 and 1 on the SDR route; HDR float endpoints are the clips exactly.

nonAdditiveDissolve.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

pixelate.semantics: Pixel blocks average their source texels at the midpoint; range is preserved by the average.

radialBlur.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

slide.semantics: Push slide; opposite directions are mirror images.

smoothCut.semantics: Blends or reveals the two clips; extended-range input survives the midpoint in HDR projects.

sparkles.semantics: Seeded sparkle field; Freecut leaves sparkles at progress 0 and 1 on the SDR route; HDR float endpoints are the clips exactly.

wipe.semantics: Hard wipe; opposite directions are mirror images.
